image_description: A close-up, slightly low-angle shot of a vintage audio cassette tape. The casing is black plastic with a white paper label on the top face featuring red handwritten text and some printed black text. Two circular windows reveal the white spools inside. A rectangular opening at the bottom exposes the dark magnetic tape. There are visible signs of wear, including scuffs on the plastic and creases on the label.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the label. AI often fails to render coherent handwriting. If the text is nonsensical but structurally resembles writing, note it as a minor artifact. Verify that the spools inside look mechanically plausible and not just like white circles.
